description: Lieux de Stationnement Naolib de Nantes Métropole is a dataset listed in Open Data Nantes Métropole, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Nantes Métropole. Lieux de stationnement de Nantes Métropole. Données rassemblant à la fois des éléments d'identification des parkings et des parkings relais en ouvrage et des parcs en enclos de la Ville de Nantes, leur géo-localisation, une présentation de chacun, des éléments sur leurs capacités d'accueil, les services proposés, les services à proximité et les moyens de ... Coverage: Nantes Métropole. The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are stationnement, Naolib, vélo, auto. The portal shows 89 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte-LO (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-nantesmetropole-fr-portal.
